title: Stimulant tripsitting

source.dataset: psychonautwiki_db.zip (psychonautwiki.db, SQLite export provided by Hany, file dated 2026-11-25)

plain_text:
Stimulant tripsitting is defined as the techniques which directly alter stimulant cognition in a manner that improves the functionality or perceived functionality of the user.

This page lists and describes the various stimulant tripsitting techniques.

Dealing with stimulant psychosis

See also

*Stimulants
